distance.formula: MMD_k^2(mu,nu) = sum_i,i' a_i a_i' k(z_i,z_i') + sum_j,j' b_j b_j' k(z_j,z_j') - 2 sum_i,j a_i b_j k(z_i,z_j)
distance.total_variation: sum of absolute aggregated coefficients after exact co-located support aggregation modulo L
distance.zero_total_variation_convention: normalization scale is one and both zero measures have zero distance
distance.signed_weights: finite signed-measure coefficients; co-located positive and negative weights cancel before TV and MMD
distance.complexity: O(N log N + M log M + U^2 + V^2 + U*V) time and O(N+M) temporary memory; U,V are unique nonzero support atoms

numeric_contract.particle_count: metadata only; never a distance multiplier

claim_limits: The exact kernel is characteristic on S^1_L x R for kappa>0 and velocity_length_scale>0.
A finite empirical MMD computation is an exact-kernel finite-sample reference up to floating-point arithmetic, not an exact-arithmetic proof.
Characteristicness does not guarantee useful finite-precision sensitivity for every bandwidth or finite sample.
This is not Wasserstein distance, total-variation distance, a field-error metric, a statistical p-value, a plasma solver, or a physics certificate.
This profile applies only to the declared 1D1V periodic-position and unbounded-velocity cohort.
The unnormalized MMD is the RKHS metric; the reported pair-normalized ratio is a scale-normalized discrepancy and is not claimed to satisfy the triangle inequality.

spatial_frequency_distribution.name: Skellam
spatial_frequency_distribution.definition: P1-P2 where P1,P2 are independent Poisson(kappa/2)
spatial_frequency_distribution.rationale: exact normalized Fourier spectrum of the periodic von Mises kernel

velocity_frequency_distribution.name: Gaussian
velocity_frequency_distribution.rationale: exact Fourier spectrum of the Gaussian velocity kernel

feature_sampling_error.claim_limit: bounds random spectral-feature error in normalized squared MMD only; not particle-sampling or physical solver error

spectral_approximation.complexity: O(N log N + M log M + D*(U+V)) time and O(N+M) temporary memory; U,V are unique nonzero support atoms
spectral_approximation.escalation_policy: If feature uncertainty overlaps a predeclared physical acceptance boundary, escalate to exact small-N oracle where feasible or trusted solver; never accept from approximation alone.

adaptive_decision.unresolved_policy: abstain; escalate to exact small-N oracle where feasible or trusted solver; never accept unresolved
adaptive_decision.optional_stopping: only preregistered checkpoint looks are covered simultaneously; do not inspect mid-batch intervals
adaptive_decision.random_stream: one deterministic SplitMix64 feature stream; no reseeding between checkpoints
adaptive_decision.claim_limit: simultaneous bound for ideal independent spectral feature draws and random-feature integration error only; not physical solver or particle-sampling error
